title: Nunchi: Ears Help Eyes in Multi-Party Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.23115v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying whom a person looks at is central to understanding multi-party conversations, yet gaze geometry alone becomes ambiguous as more people appear. Conversations offer cues that geometry lacks, such as who is speaking and what is said, but no gaze dataset provides them for many multi-party scenes. We introduce SORBET, a benchmark of 3,340 samples from 1,578 clips with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended person labels, covering more multi-party scenes than existing gaze datasets. Prior gaze models struggle to use these cues, which come in different forms, must be linked to the right person, and can conflict with gaze geometry. We propose Nunchi, a framework that constructs a text prompt from the transcript and the outputs of gaze and speaker models, links every cue to the candidates with shared labels, and lets a vision-language model (VLM) weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to identify the attended person

translated_title: Nunchi：多方对话中耳朵帮助眼睛
translated_abstract: 识别一个人正在看向谁对于理解多方对话至关重要，然而随着场景中人数增多，仅凭视线几何关系会变得模糊不清。对话本身提供了几何信息所缺乏的线索，例如谁在说话以及说了什么，但目前没有视线数据集在众多多方场景中提供这些线索。我们提出了SORBET，一个包含来自1,578个片段的3,340个样本的基准数据集，具有同步的语音、转录文本和注视对象标签，涵盖了比现有视线数据集更多的多方场景。已有的视线模型难以利用这些线索，因为它们形式各异、必须与正确的人相关联，并且可能与视线几何信息相冲突。我们提出了Nunchi框架，它从转录文本以及视线模型和说话人模型的输出中构建文本提示，通过共享标签将每条线索与候选人物关联起来，并让视觉-语言模型（VLM）权衡视线几何信息与对话线索，从而识别出被注视的人。
tldr: 该论文提出了SORBET基准数据集与Nunchi框架，通过将语音转录等对话线索与视线几何信息相结合，并利用视觉-语言模型进行权衡，实现了多方对话中被注视人物的准确识别。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SORBET, a gaze benchmark with synchronized speech, transcripts, and attended-person labels, and Nunchi, a framework that enables a vision-language model to weigh gaze geometry against conversational cues to accurately identify the attended person in multi-party conversations.
